messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I racked my brain to come up with the title, but to no avail.

output.original_text: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but to no avail.
output.joy: I racked my brain to come up with the title, and it was so much fun!
output.sadness: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but sadly, nothing came to me.
output.fear: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but what if I never think of anything?
output.anger: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but it makes me so angry that nothing worked!
output.surprise: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but I was surprised to find nothing fitting!
output.disgust: I racked my brain to come up with the title, but the thought of having nothing is just disgusting.
